name: digital-health
description: Digital health metrics models, structs, calculations, and examples.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only

rate_modules.fallible_return: Option<f64>, None iff a denominator argument is 0.0
rate_modules.panics: none of the public functions panic

money_modules.numeric_type: u32 counts in, rusty_money::Money<'static, rusty_money::iso::Currency> in and out
money_modules.fallible_return: Result<Money, rusty_money::MoneyError> — Err on currency mismatch or overflow, never on a zero count
money_modules.panics: none of the public functions panic
money_modules.wrapping_policy: each function is a one-line pass-through directly to rusty_money's own Money::mul/Money::sub, not a generic wrapper — no FormattableCurrency type parameter

modules.name: digital_referral_turnaround_time
modules.summary: Elapsed time from e-referral submission to triage decision, unit conversion, and percentile statistics over a set of durations.

functions.name: elapsed_days
functions.signature: fn elapsed_days(submission_day: f64, decision_day: f64) -> f64

functions.name: hours_to_days
functions.signature: fn hours_to_days(hours: f64) -> f64

functions.name: percentile
functions.signature: fn percentile(durations: &[f64], p: f64) -> Option<f64>
functions.formula: linear interpolation between order statistics at rank (p / 100).clamp(0, 1) * (durations.len() - 1), after sorting with f64::total_cmp

modules.name: secure_messaging_response_time
modules.summary: Elapsed time from a patient portal message to a clinician's reply, and percentile statistics over a set of response times.

functions.name: response_hours
functions.signature: fn response_hours(sent_hour: f64, replied_hour: f64) -> f64

functions.name: percentile
functions.signature: fn percentile(response_times: &[f64], p: f64) -> Option<f64>
functions.formula: linear interpolation between order statistics at rank (p / 100).clamp(0, 1) * (response_times.len() - 1), after sorting with f64::total_cmp (delegates to the same internal helper as digital_referral_turnaround_time::percentile)

modules.name: no_show_lost_revenue
